name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The company has completed a Pre-Feasibility Study outlining a US$494M after-tax NPV and 454 Moz silver-equivalent Measured & Indicated resource. AbraSilver is advancing toward a final investment decision and is backed by major shareholders including Eric Sprott and Kinross Gold.
